title: Give every criteria entry id, description, harness and expected_outcome

facts.note: The rule is triggered by criteria entries being present, whatever the artifact and whether or not they changed. No current observer reliably finds criteria entries in arbitrary artifacts, so a content-level observer is needed that detects criteria entries in any planner-authored or planner-reviewed artifact. Until that observer exists, activation cannot be derived deterministically from existing facts. No file-kind or path whitelist applies.

fires: The planner writes a new criteria entry.
The planner edits an existing criteria entry, for example by changing its harness or expected outcome.
The planner authors, revises or reviews an artifact that already holds criteria entries, even if those entries are not changed.
Any criteria entry, anywhere, lacks one of id, description, harness or expected_outcome.
doesNotFire: The artifact being authored or reviewed holds no criteria entries at all.

given: One or more criteria entries are present. This covers new, edited and existing unchanged entries, in any artifact.
when: the planner authors, edits or evaluates an artifact that holds those criteria entries
then: Every criteria entry follows the documented shape: it has all of the required fields id, description, harness and expected_outcome.
prefer: Include all four required fields (id, description, harness, expected_outcome) when you first write the entry.
When you come across an existing criteria entry that is missing a required field, add the missing field so that it matches the documented shape.
avoid: Criteria entries that leave out any of id, description, harness or expected_outcome.
Adding extra ad-hoc fields in place of a missing required field.
why: Criteria are the structured form of an acceptance. Because the shape is fixed, downstream tooling can pick the harness template and resolve the expected outcome without guessing.
evidence: A reviewer confirms that every criteria entry in the artifact, including unchanged ones, has the fields id, description, harness and expected_outcome.
The disposition is documentation-only (severity 2). Compliance is established by reviewing the artifact, not by a blocking automated check.
verifier_detail: Term documented_shape means the required fields id, description, harness and expected_outcome. The check is field presence only; the source sets no rule on the content of the values.
